title: Slitherfoot
summary: Slitherfoot is a spell which permits the user to walk on walls. It manifests itself as a blue aura around the user's legs.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[DeFoe]] used this spell at [[the Organization]]'s training ring while training in order to walk on the walls so that he could dodge the incoming attacks made by the training gym. {{Source|Absent Heroes}}
